name: Larotrectinib
mechanism: Highly selective ATP-competitive inhibitor of TRKA, TRKB and TRKC, used tumour-agnostically for NTRK fusion-positive cancers.
keyToxicities: Withdrawal pain on treatment interruption (on-target TRK effect)
interactions: Avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors and inducers.
resistance: Solvent-front (TRKA G595R, TRKC G623R), gatekeeper and xDFG mutations; off-target MAPK reactivation (KRAS, BRAF, MET).
